(1) Drive the whole look from the `sky` colour. Light sky means dawn: no stars, no cold moon, a warm low sun disc with a halo and god-rays, a sky gradient from pale gold to a soft lavender zenith, warm key light with long shadows, and hemisphere lavender fill. Dark sky keeps the current night look.
(2) Use MeshStandardMaterial PBR with procedural canvas-generated brick, flagstone and dust normal and roughness maps. Ground gets real dune terrain with no striping.
(3) Use up to 4 shadow-casting point lights plus a directional sun with PCFSoft shadows. Lantern intensity flickers.
(4) EffectComposer with UnrealBloom, GTAO, ACES, vignette, light film grain and depth of field focused on the Wanderer's target.
(5) Glow-2 thin boxes become glass or liquid materials, and the particle systems become Points.
(6) The overview camera hides ceilings, shows rim-lit silhouettes and brightens the path.
(7) Keep a hand-written v6 fallback if WebGL2 or three.js fails.
Goal: a big leap in material realism and a convincing sunrise on the landing.
